name: Monthly rotation with a MACD filter

sections.hypothesis: Adding a MACD condition to the BTC/ETH/SOL monthly rotation (a coin is held only while its daily MACD histogram is above zero at the month-end decision) makes it beat holding BTC on the scorecard where the plain rotation failed.
sections.rationale: Luke's idea (2026-11-15), tested at his request. The plain rotation lost in falling markets while still in ETH and SOL; a faster momentum check might step out sooner. Stated honestly before the run: this is a filter added after seeing where the strategy failed, the pattern that failed three times on 2026-11-14 (crash brake, HMM regime filter, MACD in volatile spells). The 200-day filter already plays this role, and a month-end MACD check only acts once a month. It can't use the holdout: the rotation's holdout is spent and its losses there are known. A pass would mean watching it forward, nothing more.
sections.rules: monthly-rotation with macd_filter 1: lookback_days 180, trend_days 200, top_n 2. At each month-end close, a coin among BTC, ETH and SOL is eligible with 180 days of history, a close above its 200-day average and a daily MACD (12, 26, 9) histogram above zero; the top 2 by 180-day return are held at half each, cash otherwise. Daily bars, 330 USDT, costs from kestrel.toml. Period 2018-01 to 2025-10, before the holdout.
sections.falsification: The full scorecard, against BTC held, with walk-forward run through the portfolio engine. Fails on any failed test. Also reported beside the plain rotation at 180 days (Sharpe 1.25, drawdown -59%, 3 of 11 walk-forward windows): the filter must at least bring the drawdown within 50%.
sections.parameters: lookback_days 180, trend_days 200, top_n 2, macd_filter 1. One run; the robustness check moves each parameter (about 8 neighbours). MACD itself stays at the textbook 12/26/9.
sections.costs: Up to a few changes each month end, slightly more than the plain rotation. Trials: 1 run plus about 8 neighbours.

history.reason: Failed the scorecard (Luke, 2026-11-15): passes edge (Sharpe 1.41 vs 0.74 for BTC), out of sample (6 of 11 windows), start dates, costs, trades and robustness, but fails drawdown (-50.7%, limit 50%) and luck (deflated 57%). Designed after seeing where the plain rotation failed; no holdout left.
